heroTitle: Everything your team needs, in one place
heroText: Check in and out, request leave, read payslips and follow performance from any device.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the e-mail and password HR gave you.
login.sessionEnded: You have been signed out. Please sign in again.
login.passwordReset: Your new password is set. Sign in with it.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your e-mail and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sentText: If {email} has an account, a reset link is on its way. It works once, within 30 minutes.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.subtitle: Pick a new password for your account.
reset.missingToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the e-mail again, or ask for a new one.

change.title: Change password
change.forcedSubtitle: You are using a temporary password. Choose a new one before you continue.
change.subtitle: Other devices will be signed out. This one stays signed in.

passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit.
